seoTitle: Text Sitemap Generator (One URL per Line)
metaDescription: Clean a URL list into a plain-text sitemap: absolute, deduplicated, percent-encoded, UTF-8. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Cleans a URL list into the text sitemap format.
why:
A text sitemap is the simplest format: one URL per line and nothing else. Google accepts it up to 50,000 URLs and 50 MB.

This tool removes duplicates, fragments, and encodes spaces and non-ASCII characters. If a line is not an absolute http(s) URL it stops and tells you which one, because the file may contain nothing but URLs.
howTo: Keep fragment removal on unless you need it.

faq.q: Why does it stop on a bad line?
faq.a: The text format allows only URLs. A stray word would break the file.
Split the list with the sitemap splitter.
